resources.name: Open-source DFT code supporting LSD (VWN) and NLSD (Becke-Perdew) with all-electron Gaussian basis sets (e.g., NWChem, CP2K, Quantum ESPRESSO, PySCF)

access.notes: The agent may choose any open-source DFT code that implements the Dirac-VWN functional for LSD and the Becke-Perdew gradient correction for NLSD.

resources.name: Double-zeta split-valence plus polarization (DZVP) Gaussian basis set for Si and H

access.url: Available in standard basis set libraries of most DFT codes (e.g., from Godbout et al., Can. J. Chem. 70, 560 (1992))
access.notes: The DZVP basis set is a standard double-zeta plus polarization basis. Many codes include it natively or provide it in their basis set repository.
